The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 in the 'Task' worksheet returned #NAME? instead of the expected float values (e.g., H46 expected -1.518795, got #NAME?). This indicates that the formulas written to the workbook use undefined names, unsupported functions, or incorrect syntax. While basic structure and net metrics passed, the statistical summary block is broken.
